recommendedTextbook.title: Basic Civic Education for Junior Secondary Schools 3
recommendedTextbook.author: M.O. Adebayo, S.A. Falade, E.O. Ajibola

topics.topic: The 1999 Constitution: Features and Constitutional Amendment Process
subtopics: Structure of the 1999 Nigerian Constitution (Preamble, Chapters, Schedules)
Rigid constitution concept: special amendment procedure requiring 2/3 majority in National Assembly and approval by 24 State Houses of Assembly
Key provisions on federal character, state creation, and fundamental objectives of state policy
objectives: Explain why the Nigerian constitution is classified as written and rigid
Outline the statutory legislative steps required to amend the 1999 Constitution

topics.topic: Democratic Governance and Pillars of Democracy in Nigeria
subtopics: Meaning of democracy ('government of the people, by the people, and for the people')
Pillars of democracy: multiparty system, independent judiciary, free press, transparent electoral body, active civil society
Advantages of democratic governance over military dictatorship in Nigeria
objectives: List 5 fundamental pillars of sustainable democracy in Nigeria
Contrast democratic governance with past military rule regarding civil liberties and freedom of speech

topics.topic: The Electoral Process: INEC, Voter Registration and Voting Protocols
subtopics: Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC): composition, constitutional duties, autonomy
Continuous Voter Registration (CVR), Permanent Voter Card (PVC), Bimodal Voter Accreditation System (BVAS)
Step-by-step voting procedures on election day: accreditation, secret balloting, sorting, counting, collation
objectives: Explain statutory functions of INEC in conducting federal and state elections
Describe how electronic accreditation (BVAS) protects electoral integrity against over-voting

topics.topic: Electoral Malpractices: Vote Buying, Rigging and Political Thuggery
subtopics: Forms of electoral malpractices: ballot snatching, vote buying, falsification of results, underage voting
Causes of electoral malpractice: desperate political greed, poverty, illiteracy, weak law enforcement
Consequences: emergence of incompetent leaders, violent unrest, waste of national resources
objectives: Analyze the destructive effects of vote trading on democratic governance and social infrastructure
Suggest institutional measures to prevent youth recruitment into political thuggery

topics.topic: National Security Agencies I: The Military, Police Force and NSCDC
subtopics: The Armed Forces of Nigeria: Army (land defense), Navy (maritime security), Air Force (airspace protection)
The Nigeria Police Force (NPF): internal law enforcement, crime investigation, public order
Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps (NSCDC): protecting critical national infrastructure (pipelines, telecommunications)
objectives: Differentiate military defense of territorial integrity from internal policing by the NPF
State statutory roles of the NSCDC in countering petroleum pipeline vandalism

topics.topic: National Security Agencies II: Intelligence and Protective Services
subtopics: Department of State Services (DSS): domestic intelligence, counter-espionage, internal security threats
Nigeria Customs Service (NCS): border protection, preventing smuggling, tariff collection
Nigeria Immigration Service (NIS): border passport control, managing expatriate quotas, tackling irregular migration
objectives: Explain how the Customs Service prevents illicit weapon smuggling into Nigerian ports
Identify statutory functions of the Immigration Service at international airports

subtopics: Diagnostic evaluation on the constitution, democracy, INEC, and security agencies
BECE standardized civic question clinic
objectives: Assess pupil performance against BECE Civic Education standards

topics.topic: Human Trafficking and Child Labor: Statutory Mandate of NAPTIP
subtopics: Meaning and forms of human trafficking (forced labor, commercial sexual exploitation, organ harvesting)
National Agency for the Prohibition of Trafficking in Persons (NAPTIP): establishment and enforcement
Protection of children: the Child Rights Act, rehabilitation of victims, prosecuting human traffickers
objectives: Identify deceitful recruitment tactics used by human traffickers targeting vulnerable youths
State NAPTIP's toll-free reporting channels and victim protection protocols

topics.topic: Anti-Corruption Agencies in Nigeria: The EFCC and ICPC
subtopics: Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC): prosecuting money laundering, advance fee fraud (419), cybercrime
Independent Corrupt Practices and Other Related Offences Commission (ICPC): investigating public sector graft and bribery
The Code of Conduct Bureau (CCB) and Code of Conduct Tribunal (CCT): asset declaration for public officers
objectives: Distinguish statutory jurisdictions between the EFCC and ICPC
Explain why public asset declaration promotes financial transparency in governance

topics.topic: Peace, Conflict Resolution and National Integration
subtopics: Meaning of peace (positive peace vs negative peace) and causes of communal conflict in Nigeria
Methods of non-violent conflict resolution: negotiation, mediation, conciliation, arbitration, judicial settlement
Promoting national integration: National Youth Service Corps (NYSC), Unity Schools, Inter-ethnic marriages
objectives: Apply mediation steps to resolve a simulated interpersonal conflict between students
Explain the founding ideals of the NYSC scheme in building national solidarity

topics.topic: Self-Reliance, Wealth Creation and Economic Self-Determination
subtopics: Economic self-reliance as a civic virtue for personal dignity and national independence
Government empowerment programs: Small and Medium Enterprises Development Agency of Nigeria (SMEDAN)
Drafting a mini-business enterprise plan incorporating book-keeping and customer service
objectives: Explain how vocational enterprise reduces poverty and crime in local government areas
Present a viable enterprise proposal for producing local commodities

topics.topic: BECE Mock Civic Education Masterclass & Speed Drills
subtopics: Full review of 3-year junior secondary Civic Education syllabus
Timed 80-question BECE Objective and Essay paper simulation
objectives: Complete standardized BECE examination questions

subtopics: Final examination administration and script moderation
objectives: Complete junior secondary civic education graduation certification
